newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CM Telecom offers 76 mln shares for SES listing.
newsitem.headline: CM Telecom offers 76 mln shares for SES listing.

text.p: Hong Kong-based CM Telecom International Ltd said on Monday it would offer 75.98 million shares at US$0.32 each as part of its listing on the new foreign board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES).
Of the total, 65.8 million shares are new shares while the balance are vendor shares.
The new shares, which represent about 22 percent of CM Telecom's enlarged issue capital, will raise net proceeds of approximately $17.5 million.

The shares are being offered in board lots of 7,000 shares. There are a total of 10,855 board lots. Of this total, 2,171 board lots at $2,240 each will be available for the public offer, while the remaining 8,684 board lots will be placed out privately at the same price.

"The issue price per share is $0.32. Based on the historical net earnings of 4.4 cents per share for the financial year ended March 31, 1996, the shares are being offered at an historical price-earnings ratio of 7.3 times," the company said in a statement.
The share offer opened on Monday and will close at noon on October 15. When listed on the SES the CM Telecom shares will be traded in U.S. dollars and in board lots of 7,000 shares each.
The primary public offering is being managed by Vickers Ballas and Co Pte Ltd.
The net proceeds will be used to finance expansion of the group's existing and related new businesses.
CM Telecom is a telecommunications company with cross-border paging services between China and Hong Kong.
